# Security Policy

## How to report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Send an email to cristian.aob@gmail.com with:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce.
- Estimated impact.

You will receive a reply within 7 days.

## Supported versions

Only the `master` branch receives security fixes.
